name: @axis/e2e
description: Phase 2 exit (test_phase2_core_loop.py): ABL agent -> Python runtime -> real Risk Kernel (gRPC) -> Postgres audit. Phase 3 exit (test_phase3_orchestration.py): multi-agent TKI run, budgets, NEXUS stage metrics, approvals end to end. Phase 5 exit (test_phase5_channels.py): one agent on web, Slack, SMS, email and voice; continuity, isolation, gated replies, transcripts in the audit chain. Phase 6 exit (test_phase6_saas.py): SSO signup, BYO key + tenant policy + budgets, metered usage that equals the audit/run log, invoice reconciliation, RBAC and cross-tenant attacks. Phase 7 exit (test_phase7_interfaces.py): every core workflow through the console, the CLI and both SDKs against the real gateway (interfaces-stack.mjs).
